page.overview:
Who is Túrin I?

Túrin I was the sixth Ruling Steward of Gondor.

Born in TA 2165, Túrin I was the third child and only son of Húrin I and was likely named after the First Age hero, Túrin Turambar.

Following the death of his father, Húrin I, in TA 2244 Túrin I became the sixth Ruling Steward of Gondor, and the sixth steward to rule during the era known as the Watchful Peace. Twice married, Túrin had several daughters and one son. Túrin's youngest child and his only son Hador was born in TA 2245 when Turin was eighty years old.

Túrin I died in the year TA 2278 after thirty-four years of rule at the age of 113 years old and was succeeded by his son Hador.
